svg.title: Electron-beam write time versus delivered current
svg.desc: Electron-beam write time per 300 mm wafer, minutes to days, versus delivered current from 1 nA to 10 mA at 10, 50 and 200 µC/cm²: 50 µC/cm² at 1 µA takes about 10 hours and 100 wafers per hour needs about 1 mA; guides at 1 and 100 wafers per hour and MAPPER's reported 1 wafer per hour.
